thesis: The speakers discuss their new book, The Compounders, which analyzes nine exceptional companies to identify common traits such as high-performing decentralized cultures, strong reinvestment engines, major owner backing, and a focus on numbers and returns. They explain that the book contrasts successful scaled American companies with smaller Swedish companies about to scale to learn from both sides of the Atlantic.
